intro: Welcome to animal school! Show me how each animal moves and sounds!
praise: Wild moves! You made that animal proud!
cheer: The animal parade was wild and wonderful!
learn-cheer: Animal school complete! Every creature taught your body a new move!
learn-s1: Bear crawl! Hands and feet down, bottom up. Roar like a bear!
learn-s2: Frog jump! Crouch low, then leap. Ribbit!
learn-s3: Crab walk! Belly to the sky. Click-click your crab claws!
learn-s4: Flamingo stand! Lift one leg and count five slow flamingo breaths. Hmmmm.
learn-s5: Cool down with a slow turtle stretch. Tuck in, then stretch long.
parade-cheer: The whole animal parade made it to the finish!
parade-s1: Parade bear! Crawl on hands and feet. ROAR!
parade-s2: Parade frog! Crouch and leap. Ribbit!
parade-s3: Parade crab! Belly up and walk. Click-click!
parade-s4: Parade flamingo! One leg and a flamingo hum. Hmmmm!
parade-s5: Invite your family to join the animal parade line!
